prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app dashboard concept at 1440×900
Primary request: Redesign the authenticated Wicker Study dashboard as ‘Focus Command’: one evidence-backed study recommendation is the unmistakable center, with all metrics demoted to supporting context.
Input images: use the screenshot of the current live Wicker Study dashboard as the identity reference for navigation chrome, warm neutral canvas, condensed headings/numerals, near-black navy ink, and single indigo signal. The other recent Study Itinerary concept is a sibling option only; do not reuse its vertical route structure or dark hero block.
Composition/framing: exact desktop product UI screenshot, straight-on, no device mockup. Keep the 200px left sidebar. A slim top strip shows ‘Thursday, 3 September’, ‘Period 1 · week 1 of 8’, and a five-period academic measure. Beneath it, place one large but restrained white working plane occupying the central upper viewport. It reads ‘Recommended next’ and features BCS1520 Statistics, ‘Continue Chapter 2’, ‘15% read’, a concise evidence line ‘Last opened 2 days ago · exam week in 39 days’, and one indigo ‘Resume Statistics’ button. The recommendation plane includes a narrow progress route and a small inline choice ‘Choose another course’, not a giant marketing hero. Under it, show a dense two-column ruled ledger: left ‘Today & due’ with nothing scheduled and exam/study week entries; right ‘Your courses’ with BCS1540 Algorithmic Design 0% and BCS1520 Statistics 15%. A small 28-day activity strip and 0-day streak sit in the page header margin rather than separate stat cards.
Style/medium: polished real SaaS UI, calm command center, compact typography, strong whitespace, one lifted plane with subtle elevation and everything else flat/ruled.
Text (verbatim where visible): ‘Wicker Study’, ‘Thursday, 3 September’, ‘Period 1 · week 1 of 8’, ‘Recommended next’, ‘BCS1520’, ‘Statistics’, ‘Continue Chapter 2’, ‘15% read’, ‘Last opened 2 days ago · exam week in 39 days’, ‘Resume Statistics’, ‘Choose another course’, ‘Today & due’, ‘Your courses’.
Constraints: functional academic UI; preserve real product meaning; accessible contrast; no marketing hero; no photography; no gradients; no glass; no oversized greeting; no generic metric-card grid; no decorative illustration; no invented commercial claims; no vertical route timeline; no watermark.
